evidence.claim: The paper incorrectly claims that rigorous statements of geodesic incompleteness must implicitly assume the Null Energy Condition, misrepresenting the BGV theorem.
evidence.excerpt: Stating that rigorous formulations of geodesic incompleteness implicitly assume the NEC misrepresents the core feature of the theorem.

judge_panel.reason: The paper does not claim the BGV theorem itself requires the NEC; rather, it notes that the loitering counterexample violates the NEC and states 'This suggests that a rigorous statement of geodesic incompleteness will implicitly include the assumption that the Null Energy Condition is satisfied, p ≥ −ρ.' This is a qualified observation about conditions under which a bounding de Sitter space can be constructed, not a misrepresentation of the BGV theorem's core assumptions—the paper explicitly presents the general BGV theorem in Section 3 without imposing the NEC.
